description_good_justification: The README says what the package does: it generates color palettes (interpolated, luminance shifts, monochromatic, complementary, triadic and more) from a base color, in many color spaces: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/README.md#about
interact_justification: The README links the documentation site (https://xn--mbius-jua.dev) for getting and using the package, and the contributing guide for feedback (GitHub issues) and contributions: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/README.md#contributing
contribution_justification: The contribution process (an issue for larger changes, pull requests against main, the required checks, sign-off): https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contributing-code
contribution_requirements_justification: Contribution requirements, including coding style and tests, are in CONTRIBUTING.md: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-style
documentation_basics_justification: The documentation site (https://xn--mbius-jua.dev) covers requirements, installation and usage; its source is in the repository: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/docs/guide/introduction/index.md#installation
documentation_interface_justification: The API reference, generated from the source comments with TypeDoc, is published at https://xn--mbius-jua.dev/api/, and the guide describes every palette and color object: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/docs/guide/usage/index.md
sites_https_justification: The repository, the npm package and the documentation site (https://xn--mbius-jua.dev, with HTTPS enforced on GitHub Pages) are served over HTTPS: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are searchable, addressable by URL and open to anyone with a GitHub account: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/issues
english_justification: All documentation is in English, and reports and comments in English are accepted.
maintained_justification: The project is actively maintained, with releases 2.1.0 to 2.3.0 and further changes in October 2026: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/releases
repo_track_justification: Git records who changed what and when: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/commits/main
repo_interim_justification: Every change is a public commit and pull request between releases, not only the releases themselves.
version_unique_justification: Every release has a unique version, tagged as <version>: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/tags
version_semver_justification: Semantic Versioning; upgrading within a major never breaks your code: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions
version_tags_justification: Each release is tagged in git: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/tags
release_notes_justification: A CHANGELOG.md generated from conventional commits, also published as GitHub release notes: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
release_notes_vulns_justification: No release has fixed a publicly known vulnerability: the repository has no security advisories. Such a fix would be listed in the release notes and a GitHub security advisory.
report_tracker_justification: Issues are tracked on GitHub: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/issues
report_responses_justification: Every issue is assigned to the maintainer when it is opened. No one outside the project has filed a bug report, so none is unanswered.
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests are answered in their GitHub issue. No one outside the project has filed one; the one outside pull request in the last 12 months (#135, an HTTPS repository URL) was answered, and the change was made.
report_archive_justification: All issues and pull requests stay public and searchable on GitHub: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reports through GitHub private vulnerability reporting (enabled) or by email: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: Reports are acknowledged within 7 days; no vulnerability has been reported in the last 6 months: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
build_justification: npm run build builds the ES module dist/moebius.js with rollup and the type declarations with TypeScript: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#development
build_common_tools_justification: npm, rollup and the TypeScript compiler.
build_floss_tools_justification: npm, Node.js, rollup and TypeScript are all FLOSS.
test_justification: A node:test suite of 225 tests, run with npm test; a packaging check (npm run check:pack) that installs the packed package and imports it; and npm run docs:check, which runs every example in the guide: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
test_invocation_justification: npm test, the standard way to run tests in an npm project.
test_most_justification: The tests cover 94.9% of the source lines, 92.7% of branches and 99.3% of functions; test:ci fails below 94% of lines, 92% of branches or 99% of functions, and coverage is uploaded to Codecov from every CI run.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: The Checks workflow lints, type-checks, builds, packs, checks the docs, builds the documentation site and runs the tests on every pull request and every push to main: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
test_policy_justification: New functionality must come with tests and bug fixes with a regression test: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
tests_are_added_justification: Recent changes came with tests: the dark mode fix (3728e32) and the diverging luminance shift fix (35c75d6) added unit tests, and the packaging and typing fixes in 2.2.x added checks to check:pack.
tests_documented_added_justification: The tests policy is part of the instructions for contributing code: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
warnings_justification: TypeScript runs in strict mode, ESLint (eslint-config-phun-ky, with Prettier rules) lints every file including Markdown, and TypeDoc treats warnings as errors.
warnings_fixed_justification: Lint has no errors and no warnings, TypeScript has no errors, and TypeDoc has no warnings.
warnings_strict_justification: TypeScript runs with strict: true, TypeDoc treats warnings as errors in CI, and lint errors fail the Checks workflow.
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer knows how to design secure software. The principles applied: one network request, which callers can avoid by passing their own color names; responses checked and rejected with an error when they are invalid; no dynamic code or storage; least-privilege CI tokens, pinned Actions, and releases with provenance. What the package guarantees and does not: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
know_common_errors_justification: The maintainer knows the common errors for this kind of software: injection and dynamic code (none: no eval or code loading), untrusted network data (the color names response is parsed as JSON and checked), supply chain (declared runtime dependencies listed in an SBOM, locked and reviewed development dependencies, pinned Actions), and unchecked input and weak randomness (documented: colors are left to chroma-js, and Math.random is not secure): https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_published_justification: moebius has no security mechanisms of its own and implements no cryptography. Its one network request, for color names, uses HTTPS through the runtime's fetch, which does the TLS. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_call_justification: moebius implements no cryptography. The only cryptography involved, TLS for the color names request, is left to the runtime's fetch (Node.js or the browser): https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_floss_justification: The only cryptography involved is TLS for the color names request, done by the runtime's fetch: Node.js (with OpenSSL) or a browser, which are available as FLOSS.
crypto_keylength_justification: moebius has no security mechanisms of its own and implements no cryptography. Its one network request, for color names, uses HTTPS through the runtime's fetch, which does the TLS. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_working_justification: moebius has no security mechanisms of its own and implements no cryptography. Its one network request, for color names, uses HTTPS through the runtime's fetch, which does the TLS. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_weaknesses_justification: moebius has no security mechanisms of its own and implements no cryptography. Its one network request, for color names, uses HTTPS through the runtime's fetch, which does the TLS. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_pfs_justification: moebius has no security mechanisms of its own and implements no cryptography. Its one network request, for color names, uses HTTPS through the runtime's fetch, which does the TLS. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_password_storage_justification: moebius stores no passwords and authenticates no users.
crypto_random_justification: moebius generates no keys or nonces. Math.random is used only for random colors, shuffles and SVG element IDs, which are not secret, as the security expectations say: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
delivery_mitm_justification: The package is delivered by npm over HTTPS with Sigstore-signed provenance, and the repository by GitHub over HTTPS.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hashes are fetched over HTTP; npm verifies package integrity from the registry metadata over HTTPS.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No release has a known vulnerability: npm audit finds none in any dependency, including the runtime dependencies chroma-js and @phun-ky/typeof, and there are no open Dependabot alerts. Fix times are set in the security policy: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerability has been found in the package or its runtime dependencies.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: No credentials are in the repository: a scan of the full git history for common token and private key patterns found none, and the two secrets are kept as GitHub Actions secrets: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#secrets
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (GitHub default setup) analyses every pull request and push to main, and ESLint runs on every pull request.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL analyses the JavaScript/TypeScript code and the GitHub Actions workflows on every push to main and every pull request, and the ruleset on main requires its results, with no errors and no high or critical security alerts, before merging: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#code-scanning
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL has never reported an alert; the ruleset blocks merging with a high or critical one.
static_analysis_often_justification: On every pull request and every push to main.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Property-based tests with fast-check run Moebius(), the palettes and the color name parsing on generated inputs on every pull request, so every release has been through them.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: All software is TypeScript on JavaScript runtimes, which are memory-safe; there is no C, C++ or other memory-unsafe code.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Few run-time assertions: options and color names are checked, but colors are left to chroma-js. Consistent input checks are planned for 3.0 (#215).
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: The property-based tests have found no exploitable vulnerability; a failing property fails CI and blocks merging until it is fixed.
achieve_passing_justification: Not awarded yet: every passing answer in this file is Met or N/A, but they are not all saved on the site. Change this to Met once the passing badge shows.
dco_justification: Every commit must be signed off under the Developer Certificate of Origin, checked on every pull request by the DCO app and required by the ruleset on main: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin
governance_justification: The maintainer-led governance model and how decisions are made: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
roles_responsibilities_justification: The maintainer and contributor roles and their responsibilities, and who holds them: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles
access_continuity_justification: One maintainer holds the access to the repository, the npm package and the documentation domain today. Releases use npm trusted publishing (no personal token), the site can be rebuilt from any fork and the code is MIT-licensed, but no second person holds access yet: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#continuity
bus_factor_justification: The project has one maintainer, so the bus factor is 1: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/graphs/contributors
documentation_roadmap_justification: What the project plans to do, consider and not do until October 2027, linking the issues: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/ROADMAP.md
documentation_architecture_justification: The source, the build, the dependency rule, the documentation site and the build scripts: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#architecture
documentation_security_justification: What users can and cannot rely on: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
documentation_quick_start_justification: Installation and a first palette, on the documentation site (https://xn--mbius-jua.dev/guide/introduction/): https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/docs/guide/introduction/index.md#quick-usage
documentation_current_justification: The API reference is generated from the source with TypeDoc on every deploy of the documentation site, CI fails on TypeDoc warnings and runs every example in the guide (npm run docs:check), and CI builds the site so dead links fail. Documentation defects are fixed as normal changes.
documentation_achievements_justification: The README shows the OpenSSF Best Practices and Scorecard badges: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/README.md
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: The package has no user interface. The documentation site uses VitePress's default theme (keyboard navigation, a skip link, landmarks), code highlighting themes picked for WCAG AA contrast in light and dark mode, and an accessibility stylesheet: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/docs/.vitepress/theme/ph/a11y.css Known gaps are tracked: the API sidebar cuts off names at desktop widths and the home page hero image has placeholder alt text, https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/issues/224
internationalization_justification: The only text meant for end users is color names, and callers can pass their own, in any language, with the colorNames option. Error messages are for developers, in English, and nothing sorts human-readable text.
sites_password_security_justification: The project sites (GitHub, npm and the documentation site on GitHub Pages) store no passwords for external users.
maintenance_or_update_justification: The current major is supported as a whole, the previous major gets high and critical security fixes for 6 months after the next one, and deprecated APIs keep working for one full major: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: No vulnerabilities have been reported to the project in the last 12 months; the repository has no security advisories.
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: Reports are made privately through GitHub private vulnerability reporting or by email. Acknowledgement within 7 days, assessment, a fix in a private GitHub security advisory, coordinated disclosure and credit: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
coding_standards_justification: Code follows the project ESLint configuration (eslint-config-phun-ky), Prettier and TypeScript in strict mode, and must pass npm run style:lint, npm run typecheck and npm run docs:check: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-style
coding_standards_enforced_justification: The Checks workflow runs ESLint (with Prettier), the TypeScript compiler in strict mode and TypeDoc on every pull request, and the ruleset on main requires it to pass before merging.
build_standard_variables_justification: No native binaries are built; rollup and TypeScript compile TypeScript to JavaScript.
build_preserve_debug_justification: dist/moebius.js is minified, but ships a source map that embeds the original TypeScript sources, so stack traces and debuggers map to the original code.
build_non_recursive_justification: npm run build runs rollup once with one configuration (rollup.config.js), then two scripts that fix the declaration imports and write the licences.
build_repeatable_justification: Dependencies are locked in package-lock.json and installed with npm ci; rebuilding the same source gives byte-identical output (dist built from the 2.3.0 tag matched the published 2.3.0 tarball byte for byte).
installation_common_justification: The package is installed and removed with npm: npm install @phun-ky/moebius and npm uninstall @phun-ky/moebius.
installation_standard_variables_justific: Installation is done entirely by npm, which honours its standard location settings (--prefix, npm_config_prefix, global or local). The package has no preinstall, install or postinstall scripts.
installation_development_quick_justifica: git clone, npm ci, npm run build and npm test give the full development and test environment: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#development
external_dependencies_justification: Every dependency is listed in package.json and locked in package-lock.json. The runtime dependencies, chroma-js and @phun-ky/typeof, are declared in dependencies, imported rather than bundled (check:pack enforces it), and listed in the SBOM on each GitHub release: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/package.json
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot checks npm dependencies and GitHub Actions weekly and opens security updates as soon as an advisory is published, and dependency review checks every pull request: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
updateable_reused_components_justificati: No third-party code is copied into the repository; all external components come from npm through package.json and the lockfile, and Dependabot opens update pull requests. Runtime dependencies use caret ranges, so consumers get their fixes without a moebius release.
interfaces_current_justification: The code uses current interfaces: ES modules, the Fetch API, Node 24 in CI, TypeScript 6 in strict mode, and current GitHub Actions pinned to commit SHAs. An exports map is planned for 3.0 (#183).
automated_integration_testing_justificat: The Checks workflow lints, type-checks, builds, packs and installs the package and imports it, checks the API docs and runs the guide examples, builds the documentation site and tests with coverage, on every pull request and push to main, reporting results as GitHub checks with coverage uploaded to Codecov.
regression_tests_added50_justification: 6 of the 9 bug fixes in the last six months came with a test or check that fails without them: unit tests for dark mode (3728e32) and the diverging luminance shift (35c75d6), and check:pack checks for the published declarations (388f9cb), the bundled licences (a8e43a6) and the published types (7f3c3c5, afef776).
test_statement_coverage80_justification: Line coverage of the source (tests and type definitions excluded), measured with Node built-in coverage on every CI run and uploaded to Codecov, is 94.9%. test:ci fails below 94% of lines, 92% of branches or 99% of functions.
test_policy_mandated_justification: New functionality must come with tests and bug fixes with a regression test: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
implement_secure_design_justification: Secure design principles applied: fail-safe handling of the network response (an error status, invalid JSON or names in the wrong shape throw instead of being used), economy of mechanism (no dynamic code, no storage), least privilege in CI, and open design. The default color names URL, a deprecated third-party service, is the exception and goes in 3.0 (#184): https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: moebius has no security mechanisms of its own and implements no cryptography. Its one network request, for color names, uses HTTPS through the runtime's fetch, which does the TLS. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_credential_agility_justification: moebius has no security mechanisms of its own and implements no cryptography. Its one network request, for color names, uses HTTPS through the runtime's fetch, which does the TLS. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_used_network_justification: The one network request, for color names, goes to https://color-names.herokuapp.com/v1/ by default, over HTTPS. Plain HTTP is used only if the caller passes an http: URL: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_tls12_justification: TLS is done by the runtime's fetch. Node.js 22.9 and later, the supported versions, and current browsers use TLS 1.2 or later by default, and moebius does not change it.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: fetch verifies TLS certificates by default, and moebius passes no TLS options and does not turn verification off.
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: The color names request is a plain GET; moebius adds no headers, cookies or credentials to it, and fetch verifies the certificate before sending anything.
signed_releases_justification: Releases are published from GitHub Actions with npm trusted publishing and carry Sigstore-signed provenance; the signing identity comes from GitHub OIDC, not a key on npm. Verification with npm audit signatures is documented: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases
version_tags_signed_justification: Release tags are annotated but not signed; releases are verified through npm provenance instead.
input_validation_justification: The untrusted input, the color names response, is checked: an error status, a body that is not JSON, names in an unsupported shape or an empty list are rejected with an error. Options that are not an object throw a TypeError, and colors are parsed by chroma-js, which rejects invalid strings, as documented in the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
hardening_justification: Strict TypeScript, no eval or dynamic code, nothing written to globals or storage, the network response parsed as JSON only, read-only CI permissions with SHA-pinned actions, CodeQL on every change, and a pack check before every release.
assurance_case_justification: No assurance case yet. The security expectations say what users can and cannot rely on, but there is no written threat model, trust boundaries or list of the weaknesses countered: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
osps_ac_01_01_justification: The maintainer, the only person with access, uses two-factor authentication on GitHub, which GitHub requires for code contributors. Anyone given access later must use it too: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#becoming-a-maintainer
osps_ac_02_01_justification: GitHub requires a role to be chosen for every collaborator invited to the repository, and the governance requires the lowest role that fits: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#becoming-a-maintainer
osps_ac_03_01_justification: The ruleset on main (main: merge rules) requires changes to arrive through a pull request with passing checks. Only the admin role can bypass it, which the release workflow uses to push its commit and tag.
osps_ac_03_02_justification: A separate ruleset on main (main: protect history), with no bypass, blocks deleting the branch and force pushes.
osps_br_01_01_justification: No workflow interpolates untrusted metadata, such as pull request titles or branch names, into a script; github.actor is passed through an environment variable: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/.github/workflows/publish.yml
osps_br_01_03_justification: Pull requests run on the pull_request event, where forks get no secrets. The labeler runs on pull_request_target but never checks out or runs pull request code, with only pull-requests and issues write. Publishing runs only after a merge.
osps_br_03_01_justification: All official channels use HTTPS: the GitHub repository, the npm package and the documentation site (https://xn--mbius-jua.dev): https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius
osps_br_03_02_justification: The package is distributed by npm over HTTPS, and each release carries a Sigstore-signed provenance attestation: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases
osps_br_07_01_justification: GitHub secret scanning and push protection are not enabled yet, so nothing blocks a commit that contains a secret. Secrets are kept only in GitHub Actions secrets, and .env files are ignored by git: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#secrets
osps_do_01_01_justification: The documentation site (https://xn--mbius-jua.dev) covers installation, every palette and the color objects, with the API reference: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/docs/guide/usage/index.md
osps_do_02_01_justification: How to report a bug, with an issue template: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#reporting-bugs
osps_gv_02_01_justification: Proposed changes and usage problems are discussed in public GitHub issues and pull requests: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/issues
osps_le_02_01_justification: The source code is under the MIT licence, which is OSI-approved: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/LICENSE
osps_le_02_02_justification: The released npm package is under the MIT licence, declared in package.json; its runtime dependencies are under MIT (@phun-ky/typeof) and BSD-3-Clause and Apache-2.0 (chroma-js), all OSI-approved: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/LICENSE
osps_le_03_01_justification: The licence is in the LICENSE file at the repository root: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/LICENSE
osps_le_03_02_justification: The published package includes the licence text in its LICENSE file; its runtime dependencies are installed from npm with their own licences: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/LICENSE
osps_qa_01_01_justification: The repository is public at https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius
osps_qa_01_02_justification: The full git history, with authors and dates, is public: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/commits/main
osps_qa_02_01_justification: Direct dependencies are listed in package.json, with every version locked in package-lock.json: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/package.json
osps_qa_04_01_justification: The project has a single repository, which holds the package and its documentation site.
osps_qa_05_01_justification: No generated executables are committed: build output (dist) is ignored, and the package is built in CI.
osps_qa_05_02_justification: The only binary files in the repository are PNG images for the documentation; there are no executables or library files.
osps_vm_02_01_justification: Security contacts (email and GitHub private vulnerability reporting): https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
osps_ac_04_01_justification: Every workflow sets read-only permissions at the top level, and jobs ask only for what they need: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
osps_br_02_01_justification: Every release has a unique Semantic Versioning version, tagged as <version>: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/releases
osps_br_04_01_justification: A CHANGELOG.md generated from conventional commits, listing features, fixes and breaking changes, also published as GitHub release notes: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
osps_br_05_01_justification: Dependencies are installed with npm ci from the lockfile in every pipeline: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/.github/workflows/publish.yml
osps_br_06_01_justification: Every release is published with a Sigstore-signed provenance attestation, verifiable with npm audit signatures: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases
osps_do_06_01_justification: How dependencies are chosen, obtained and tracked: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
osps_gv_01_01_justification: Who has access to the repository, the npm package and the documentation domain: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#continuity
osps_gv_01_02_justification: The maintainer and contributor roles and their responsibilities: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles
osps_gv_03_02_justification: Requirements for code contributions: style, tests, sign-off, commits and pull requests: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contributing-code
osps_le_01_01_justification: Every commit must carry a Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off, checked on every pull request by the DCO app and required by the ruleset on main: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin
osps_qa_03_01_justification: The ruleset on main requires the status checks (check, DCO and dependency-review) and CodeQL results to pass before merging; only the admin role can bypass it.
osps_qa_06_01_justification: The Checks workflow builds and runs the tests, the pack check and the guide examples on every pull request, and must pass before merging: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
osps_sa_01_01_justification: The architecture (the source, the build, the dependency rule, the documentation site and the build scripts): https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#architecture
osps_sa_02_01_justification: Moebius() and the classes it returns, with their options, return values and errors, are described in the API reference generated from the source (https://xn--mbius-jua.dev/api/) and in the guide; the one network request is described in the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/docs/guide/usage/index.md
osps_sa_03_01_justification: The security expectations assess the most likely and impactful problems (the default third-party color names service, no timeout, unchecked colors, insecure randomness and the runtime dependencies), and are reviewed when features change: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
osps_vm_01_01_justification: Coordinated disclosure, with acknowledgement within 7 days and a fix within 30 days for serious issues: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
osps_vm_03_01_justification: Private reporting through GitHub private vulnerability reporting or the security email: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
osps_vm_04_01_justification: Vulnerabilities are published as GitHub security advisories when fixed: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/security/advisories
osps_ac_04_02_justification: Each job declares only the permissions it needs, for example the labeler has pull-requests and issues write and publishing has id-token: write: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/.github/workflows/label.yml
osps_br_01_04_justification: Workflows take no manual inputs, and the only collaborator-controlled value used, github.actor, is passed through an environment variable: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/.github/workflows/publish.yml
osps_br_02_02_justification: Each release is a versioned npm package and a GitHub release with the same tag, and since 2.2.2 its SBOM is named moebius-<version>.cdx.json: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/releases
osps_br_07_02_justification: How secrets are stored, accessed and rotated: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#secrets
osps_do_03_01_justification: How to verify release integrity with npm audit signatures: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases
osps_do_03_02_justification: How to check that a release was built by the publish workflow in phun-ky/moebius, from its provenance: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases
osps_do_04_01_justification: The current major (2.x) is supported as a whole; the previous major gets high and critical security fixes for 6 months after the next major is released: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions
osps_do_05_01_justification: A major stops getting security updates 6 months after the next major is released; for 1.x that was November 2025: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions
osps_gv_04_01_justification: Collaborators are reviewed, including two-factor authentication, before getting escalated permissions: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#becoming-a-maintainer
osps_qa_02_02_justification: Every GitHub release since 2.2.2 has a CycloneDX SBOM attached, generated by the publish workflow; from 3.0 it lists the runtime dependencies (npm sbom): https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases
osps_qa_04_02_justification: The project has a single repository, so there are no subprojects in other repositories.
osps_qa_06_02_justification: When and how the tests run, locally and in CI: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
osps_qa_06_03_justification: New functionality and bug fixes must come with tests: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
osps_qa_07_01_justification: The project has one maintainer, so no non-author approval is possible yet. A review by a maintainer other than the author is required once there is a second maintainer: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#reviews
osps_sa_03_02_justification: No threat model or attack surface analysis is written down yet; the security expectations cover what users can and cannot rely on: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
osps_vm_04_02_justification: No VEX document yet. The one advisory accepted in dependency review (braces, a development dependency that is not in the package) is explained in the security policy instead: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
osps_vm_05_01_justification: Thresholds for fixing vulnerability and licence findings in dependencies: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
osps_vm_05_02_justification: The policy for dependency findings before a release: a critical or high finding in a runtime dependency blocks merging and releasing, and is fixed and released within 7 days: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
osps_vm_05_03_justification: Dependency review checks every pull request against the GitHub Advisory Database and blocks high or critical findings in runtime and development dependencies, as the documented policy says: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/.github/workflows/dependency-review.yml
osps_vm_06_02_justification: The ruleset on main blocks merging while CodeQL reports an error or a high or critical security alert: https://github.com/phun-ky/moebius/blob/main/SECURITY.md#code-scanning
